name_en: WQ101 Alpha8 Open Return Sum Rank
name_zh: WQ101 Alpha8 开盘收益和排名
formula_zh: -rank(5期开盘和*5期收益和 - 10期前同项)
intuition_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 15h bars.
intuition_zh: 源自WQ101论文的Alpha公式，适配15小时K线。
expected_direction_explanation_en: Direction intentionally left conditional to avoid post-hoc fitting. Empirical diagnostics required.
expected_direction_explanation_zh: 方向故意设为条件式以避免事后拟合。需实证诊断。
known_limitations_en: Open and return rolling sums mix price scale with returns; cross-sectional rank can be dominated by high-price names.
known_limitations_zh: 开盘价和收益滚动和混合了价格尺度与收益；截面排名可能受高价格标的主导。
horizon_notes_en: Lookback window: 15 bars. Evaluation covers 1h/4h/24h/72h horizons.
horizon_notes_zh: 回溯窗口：15根K线。评价覆盖1h/4h/24h/72h视野。
status_explanation_en: Status: DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE. Diagnostic probe — not yet promoted to active signal.
status_explanation_zh: 状态：DIAGNOSTIC_PROBE。诊断探针——尚未升级为活跃信号。
qa_notes_zh: 源自WQ101论文的Alpha公式，适配15小时K线。
qa_notes_en: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 15h bars.
main_strengths_zh: 计算完整性(90); 稳定性(80)
main_weaknesses_zh: 分位形状(40); 方向可解释性(30)
review_notes_zh: 元数据质量: NEEDS_REVIEW; 需人工审查公式或元数据; QA: 源自WQ101论文的Alpha公式，适配15小时K线。
review_notes_en: Metadata quality: NEEDS_REVIEW; Formula or metadata needs human review; QA: Alpha formula from WQ101 paper, adapted for 15h bars.
review_subreason_zh: 主要是批量接入后的元数据/解释待补齐，不等于因子失效。
review_subreason_en: Mainly metadata/explanation cleanup after bulk intake; not evidence that the factor failed.
ml_gate_reason_zh: 可作为候选特征进入机器学习，但带元数据风险标记。
ml_gate_reason_en: Eligible as an ML candidate feature with a metadata risk flag.
main_diagnostic_note_zh: 毛收益尚可但费用敏感，10bps下收益崩溃
main_diagnostic_note_en: Gross returns acceptable but cost-sensitive; collapses at 10bps
